newsitem.title: TURKEY: SOCCER-FENERBAHCE CHAIRMAN FIGHTS FEDERATION BAN.
newsitem.headline: SOCCER-FENERBAHCE CHAIRMAN FIGHTS FEDERATION BAN.

text.p: Fenerbahce chairman Ali Sen, currently banned from conducting official business at the club, is fighting for the resignation of Turkish soccer federation chairman Senes Erzik and calling for mass demonstrations to support his demands.

"Erzik should resign before I get back to Turkey," Sen said from a Fenerbahce training camp in Portugal, according to the Wednesday edition of the Turkish daily Yeni Yuzyil. Fenerbahce and Sen are due to return on Thursday.
Sen has called a special meeting of Fenerbahce for Saturday to discuss a row between the club and the federation.
The dispute centres on a two-month ban on Sen imposed by the federation over insulting remarks he made at a referee and comments to the press.

"If the extraordinary meeting on January 18 supports me, I will say that I do not recognise the federation," said Sen, who plans to call for mass demonstrations against the federation by supporters in Turkey's major cities until the charges against him are dropped.
Champions Fenerbahce's hopes of reaching the European Cup quarter-finals were dashed early last month when Juventus beat them 2-0 in Turin.
